shots.motion: Slow forward camera move toward an empty lantern bridge.
shots.end_pose: The bridge center is established. The frame stays empty.

shots.motion: Two figures take one step toward each other on the stone bridge.
shots.end_pose: Both stop with their shoes on the stone and their hands separated.

shots.motion: In close-up the two free hands reach and clasp once.
shots.end_pose: The hands stay joined through the last frame.
